Subject: Renewal & Growth Planning — BrightWave 2029 commitment window

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to kick off the renewal and expansion planning for BrightWave's 2029 commitment window so we can lock in capacity and pricing before year-end. High-level ask from our side: establish a mutual timeline, confirm stakeholders (procurement / legal / engineering), and pick a QBR slot to finalize capacity and upsell targets.

Proposed timeline (suggested):
- Nov 9–16: stakeholder roster & initial capacity targets (you)
- Nov 17–24: internal pricing/contract prep (Redwood)
- Dec 1–8: QBR + mutual action plan sign-off

Potential QBR slots (PST):
- Tue Dec 5, 11:00–12:00
- Wed Dec 6, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Dec 8, 09:00–10:00

Deliverables attached: renewal_summary.pdf (current usage, baseline), plus a short playbook stub. Can you confirm who from BrightWave should be on the invite (procurement/legal/engineers)? Also, any initial uplift targets (tokens/throughput or committed GPUs) would help us prepare the draft.

Next steps: please reply with stakeholders and preferred QBR slot; Ben will own pricing models, Monica will own onboarding/CS ops. I'll coordinate contracting and notes.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

- renewal_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

For uplift: our preliminary ask is +60% token throughput during peak hours (we can be more specific after an internal usage review). I'll attach a quick forecast sheet with rough numbers.

Preferred QBR slot from our side: Wed Dec 6, 14:00–15:00 PST. If that works for Redwood, please send calendar invite to the full list.

Thanks for the note. Quick readout from infra: +60% peak is feasible with a combination of provisioning and burst capacity — we recommend:
- Stage 1 (Jan–Mar): +30% committed (reserve capacity)
- Stage 2 (Apr–Jun): move to +60% with burst policies and autoscale buffers

I'll attach a short ops note in the QBR packet. Pricing-wise, we can offer a step-down on unit price at the Stage 2 commitment if BrightWave signs a 12-month reserved capacity addendum. Ben — if you want, I'll precompute cost deltas for the two-stage approach and drop them into the playbook.

Rohan
Sr. Infrastructure PM — Redwood Inference
